lokele: Imi Paulo, ko la lisangi lia Mungu yende Botomomu wa Masiya Yesu, la Timoteo etungani yasu, liseeli end’eba Etanda ya Mungu nda Kolinto la ende ebasüchomo batotina nda yese etotina ya Akaya,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ 1:1 Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

lokele: bootaota end’ino la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango wasu la elia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Mungu la Sango wa Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya ainelomoko la loomalo, ako Sango wa Booto la Mungu wa liɔngɛsi litotina,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

lokele: oyatɔɔngɛkɛsɛ betema yasu nda bifembi yasu bitoti, mbo tokɔkɔlɛkɛ ndɔɔngɛsɛ betema ya bato basi nda bifembi eyau ko la liɔngɛsi elisɔɔngɛsɔmɔkɔ iso ko la Mungu.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

lokele: Mbo kwa asoelwa bemusi ya Masiya end’iso, ko ongoma liɔngɛsi lia Masiya lisoelwel’iso.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

lokele: Tookesomo bifembi, ele ko litina mbo bɔɔngɛsɔmɔkɔ la mbo buwesomoko nda yao, la tɔɔngɛsɔmɔkɔ nda bifembi eyasu ele imɔ ko l’eoka ya elianu liɔngɛsi, ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ ino ndotendela bifembi ebitokak’iso imɔ ko kwani.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

lokele: Iyɛli shasu eoka yanu sitieyaeye, eoka tosoluwa mbo kwa asowatema ino lasu nda bemusi, ko ongoma otowatema ino ko lasu nda liɔngɛsi lia yao.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

lokele: Bitungani yami, totilɛmbɛ ino ndoyala botutuku loasɔ loa bifembi biwau eyayaka end’iso nda Asia, mbo twanyɛlɔmɔkɔ nyɛi ndolongela bofoka wasu, ongoma angwɛnɛ imɔ iyɛli sha liwawi shatikalaka lasu.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, 1:8 concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

lokele: Eingo nde, nda betema yasu angɛnɛ twokakä lofomu se loa liwa; litina mbo totalendelo bofoka wasu angɛnɛ, kangä ko Mungu oyatotɛmɔlɔ ebasowa.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

lokele: Ende Inde oyasɔɔnɔkɔl’iso nda liwa libe la atɔɔnɔkɔlɔ iso imɔ liasi la tosolendelo ko Inde mbo elaɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ iso nda liwa.
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

lokele: Ani ino otosungakan’imɔ lasu ko la basomboli banu mbo bato wike bafaekefeke Mungu kelekele eoka yasu loasɔ loa bondanda ewafomoko iso eoka ya basomboli wike.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your 1:11 behalf.

lokele: Eoka loomalo loasu lole mbo botema bosoenyeles’iso wewe mbo beyaeli yasu ende eba wenda-bo, simbi to end’ino, biengani nde la botanu la liengani lia Mungu angɛnɛ, inga nda wɛlï wa balomboki, kangä la booto wa Mungu.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

lokele: Eoka totisɔnɛl’ino loasɔ ango lɔmɔi sakolo ngo ko loao elosotangak’ino la elosolembeel’ino wewe, la iyɛli shami sile mbo olembeeleke loao ko nda tuu fololo,
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

lokele: kwa asolembeela ino botuku wa njasɔ kongo, la mbo wende la litina liomala eoka yasu, kwa iso imɔ tolaomalaka nde loasɔ loanu nda lise lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu. Loasɔ loa lɔkɛndɔ eloasiakoya Paulo nda Kolinto oso
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

lokele: La eoka yaluwaka ongoma la wɛlï, yasiaka ndotayɛnɛ ino ko oso, mbo yɔlɛsɛk’ino limɛngɔ liasi imɔ
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

lokele: nda lɔkɛndɔ ko nda Makedonia la liasi nda liinywi liami ndosokwa nda Makedonia limɔ ndotikomo lanu nda lɔkɛndɔ loami nda Yudea.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

lokele: Asangaka to imi ani, ¿mbo isoeyaeyaka? ¿Mbo itotika lisakä la Eingo ee, la Mbayo, kwa atokelaka basenji kongo?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

lokele: Kwa ayali nde Mungu wolendelomo, ko ongoma lioi liasu end’ino litieyaeye, Eingo ee, la Mbayo!
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

lokele: Eoka Wana wa Mungu ako Yesu Masiya oyanangolomoko end’ino ko lasu ako Silwano la Timoteo, Inde atieyaeye nda Eingo ee la Mbayo, nde Inde ale wewe ko Eingo ko.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

lokele: Inde nd’atokɔchaka basakä batotina ba Mungu mbo Eingo. Eokao ko la Yesu, iso mbo— Ongoma ende Mungu la lotaliomo tala yande.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

lokele: Ale ko Mungu oyasokɔkɔmɛs’iso lanu imɔ lisanga nda liuwesi lia Yesu, Oyasüch’iso,
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

lokele: la oyasot’iso ndembe ya chapa yande la oyasof’iso Bolimo wande kwa tukä nda betema yasu.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

lokele: Imi nd’atosingwa lina lia Mungu mbo lioi liami lile wewe mbo itiaɛkɛ nda Kolinto mbo itaokes’ino sɔni finɛ.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

lokele: Loti to mbo tosolɛmbɛ ndoyala ngɛnɛ wa liimeli lianu, kongo ko tosolɛmbɛ ndosungana lanu loasɔ loa bootaota wanu eoka ino osokɔkɔmɔ nda liimeli lianu.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

lokele: Yasangaka to mbo imi angoya imɔ end’ino ndokes’ino botema wale liasi.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

lokele: ¿Yokes’ino botema wale, ndai to komalesaka’mi liasi sakolo ngo inde angɛnɛ oyasokesomoko wale ko lami?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

lokele: Eokao isotomel’ino lokasa mbo akayeke’mi itaoka botema wale loasɔ loa bato ebasokɔkɔlɔ ndokesa’mi limɛngɔ; yaimelaka loasɔ loanu yaatotina mbo limɛngɔ eliami lile imɔ ko limɛngɔ lianu.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

lokele: Yasɔnɛlɛk’ino lokasa la efembi la botema wale finɛ la foo wike imɔ, inga to mbo yokesek’imɔ ko ino botema wale, kangä ndoluwes’ino losamɔ lofi finɛ eloami end’ino.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

lokele: Eya to mbo boto ɔmɔi asokes’iso botema wale, atiokese ko imi angɛnɛ kongo, kangä ino batotina sumbu, mbo itakɛsɛ loasɔ la oso.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

lokele: Likuchi elisokuchomo lande ko lanu batotina, lisoengana to lande,
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

lokele: lole loanu to ndomɛsɛl’inde la ndɔɔnjɔnj’inde mbo atalongomo la ikɛnɛnɛ sifi.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

lokele: Eokao isoombel’ino mbo okɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ losamɔ loanu end’inde liasi,
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

lokele: eoka ko la litina-li imi losɔnɛl’ino lokasa-lo mbo ikɔtɔlɛk’ino kwa mbo wende la lilitesi nda njasɔ bitotina.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

lokele: Bomɛsɛlɛ asisa loasɔ, imi imɔ komɛsɛlɛ inde; la oyasomɛsɛlɔmɔ lanu, asomɛsɛlɔmɔ imɔ ko lami ko l’eoka yanu nda baiso ba Masiya,
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

lokele: mbo totafa Satana fofe yolong’iso; eoka totiunge shɔngɔlɔ shande.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

lokele: Aɛkɛ’mi nda Tuloa ndokanangokola Mboli Ilau ya Masiya, bome wa fofe ya likuwa bosolioelomo’mi loasɔ loa Ngɛnɛ;
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

lokele: kongo ko botema wami botiae se eoka itiɛnɛkɛ etungani ako Tito. Eokao asɛnyanaka’mi la bato b’omao, imi lɔkɛ nda Makedonia.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

lokele: Nde kelekele ende Mungu oyatokɛsɛkɛnɛ lasu mbile bitotina nda bolenga wa bowangɔ ko la Masiya la oyatofafanesa liluwani lia njasɔ yande ko lasu nda bilela bitotina kwa atofafana liɛsɛ lilau.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

lokele: Twende to liɛsɛ elisofecha Masiya ofechela Mungu la elisoeolaka ebasouwekesomo la ebasosɛɛsɛlɛk’imɔ;
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

lokele: ende ebasosɛɛsɛlɛ, kwa liɛsɛ lia liwa liokɛsɛnɛ lau nda liwa, kongo ko ende eba liuwesi, liɛsɛ lia liwawi liokɛsɛnɛ lau nda loiko. ¿Ndai to atoengana ndokɛsɛnɛ nda bolenga-bo?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

lokele: Toti to kwa ayali wike, ebatokɛndɛkɛndɛ bokalala wa Lioi lia Mungu, kongo ko twende ebatonangola amamwito la Masiya ko la momongo kwa ebatoyala oso wa baiso ba Mungu.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

lokele: ¿Mbo tosoakola ko ndoongel’iso angɛnɛ? ¿Mbo twende la boeno wa lokasa, kwa bato bamɔi bende la boeno wa lokasa, loko lokasa loongela iso end’ino, kwa lokasa loanu ndoongel’iso ende basi?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

lokele: Ino angɛnɛ wende lokasa loasu loongel’iso, elososɔnɔmɔ ko nda betema yanu, lokasa elosoluwana la elosotangokomo la bato batotina;
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

lokele: la lokasa-lo losɔɛnɛlɛ fololo mbo lole loa Masiya la losoeshomo lami, lotisɔnɔmɔ la wino, kangä la Bolimo wa Mungu wa Loiko; lotisɔnɔmɔ nda batalɛ kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ bikela, kangä nda betema ya balomboki.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

lokele: Nde iso tosoluwa ndoluwa ongoma ko l’eoka ya Masiya loasɔ loa Mungu angɛnɛ;
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

lokele: loti to mbo toondu nde iso angɛnɛ ndotanga mbo loende ko loasɔ loasu, kangä ko loasɔ loa Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

lokele: Mungu nd’asof’iso isosha shoyala baekesi ba ngɛla eyai, eko ngɛla eyetitomo nda lokasa, kangä nda Bolimo; eoka bikela eyasɔnɔmɔkɔ bitoola bato, kongo ko Bolimo ale bofaefi wa loiko.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

lokele: Eya to mbo isosha sha liwa eshatomoko la bikela nda batalɛ loeshomo la bɔfɛkɔ wa use bokufesa bana ba Isalaele mbo batatichaka bɔmbɔ wa Mɔsɛ ko l’eoka ya liangangi lifi, ani liangangi lisambotiyama,
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

lokele: monito bɔfɛkɔ wa isosha sha Bolimo angolongela esha liwa ko fɛɛ?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

lokele: Ango bofɛkɔ wa isosha shofaka bato se shaaka sifi, nde simbi to isosha shoenganesa bobe wa bato sisolongela la bɔfɛkɔ wa likama.
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

lokele: Eingo, eshaaka la bɔfɛkɔ oso, kwani siti ’mɔ la bɔfɛkɔ, ko la litina-li liko mbo bɔfɛkɔ wa kwani bosoeta fɛɛ;
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

lokele: eoka ango yao eyesosɛɛsɛlɛ eyala la bɔfɛkɔ, simbi to eyelatikalaka koyala la bɔfɛkɔ woeta.
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

lokele: Eoka ya iyɛli sifi esile lasu tosotendela ndoonga fololo,
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

lokele: inga kwa Mɔsɛ oyalinjaka bɔmbɔ wande l’esinda mbo bana ba Isalaele batawɛlɛ losilo loa bɔfɛkɔ ebosambotiyama bonono.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

lokele: Nde betema yau loyala betutuku; ko ongoma ko nda eweuse ani atotangomo lokasa loa Ngɛla ya oso, esinda ekotikala angosokolomo nda betema yau, eoka etosokolomo ko l’eoka ya Masiya kongo.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

lokele: Eingo, ko nda eweuse ani atotangomo Lokasa loa Mɔsɛ, ende kwa mbo esinda esolinja betema yau;
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

lokele: kongo ko atokikwa boto ende Ngɛnɛ wasu, lamao esinda esowatolomo.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu ende to Bolimo, nde olo ayali Bolimo wa Ngɛnɛ ko omao bato batikandakomo imɔ.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

lokele: Nde iso yaatotina ani biɔmbɔ yasu bitilinjakomo imɔ, limɔ tosɔɛnɛ bɔfɛkɔ wa Ngɛnɛ wasu kwa mbo wɛ̈li wa talatala la tosokindolomo nda bɔfɔnɔ wande wa bɔfɛkɔ ko ndomacha bɔfɛkɔ wa oso, eoka wao bosoyael’iso ko la Ngɛnɛ Bolimo angɛnɛ.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

lokele: Eokao ani ayalak’iso la isosha-si ko l’eoka ya booto, toitowa esole;
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

lokele: nde tosomachaka njasɔ ya wisakumbo ebile la sɔni, tosofeka ndotimbana la bolimbake, la ndofenyaka wɛndi wa Mungu, kongo ko ani atoisokol’iso wɛndi wa wewe, tosolembeelesa batotina nda betema yau mbo toengani nde la likuwa-li nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

lokele: Nde ango Mboli Ilau ebitonangol’iso belinjakomo, ambo bisolinjakomo ko end’iyo ebasokasɛɛsɛlɛ.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

lokele: Limɔ mungu wa wenda wa mbile-ye asolinjaka betema ya ebatiimele Ngɛnɛ mbo bataɛnɛ bonyanya wa Mboli Ilau ya tala ya Masiya, Oyayali la liluku lia Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

lokele: Eoka totiteke boekï wa njasɔ yasu angɛnɛ, kangä eya Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu, iso tole ko bɛkɔwa yanu loasɔ loa Yesu.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

lokele: Eoka ale ko Mungu oyaongaka mbo— Bonyanya wa löwa botosɔswa nda lilima. Inde angɛnɛ asoanesa betema yasu ndoangangesa liluwani lia tala ya Mungu eyesoanganga nda bɔmbɔ wa Masiya. Bifembi ebitoyaka ende Botomomu wa Yesu
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” Genesis 1:3 who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

lokele: Kongo ko tososɛlɛ bondanda-bo wa loketi nda tei ya tɔlɔngɔ mbo bato baluweke mbo bofoka bofi wa wɛndi-bo boti wasu, kangä ewa Mungu.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

lokele: Tosokuwamelomo la fangi bitotina, nde tokamiakomu; tosowaka itɔɔ nde totiwe esole;
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

lokele: basokaeng’iso, nde totimachomo la Mungu; tosokwesomo konda nyɛlɛ, nde totisɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔ.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

lokele: Tosokɛndɛkɛndɛ lise lia lise la nda bindo yasu ko lienyakeli lia liwa eliawaka Yesu, mbo loiko loa Yesu imɔ lɔɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ nda bindo yasu.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

lokele: Lise la lise kwa ayal’iso la liwawi, tosofakomo nda besamba ya liwa ndowa loasɔ loa Yesu, ko mbo loiko loa Yesu lɔɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ nda bindo yasu balomboki ebatowaka.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

lokele: Ongoma to, liwa nd’atokuwel’iso, nde loiko lotowawes’ino.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

lokele: Ani asoyal’iso la bolimo wa liimeli ko la bɔfɔnɔ ewayalaka lande oyasɔnɔkɔ mbo— Isoimela, eokao isoonga. La iso imɔ tosoimela, eekao tosokaongake,
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” Psalms 116:10 We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

lokele: eoka tosoluwa mbo Inde oyatɛmwɛsɛkɛ Ngɛnɛ Yesu nda liwa, ɛ̈tɛmwɛsɛkɛ imɔ ko iso amamwito la Yesu la ëmesaka nd’iso amamwito lanu oso wande.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through 4:14 with through Jesus, and will present us with you.

lokele: Bitotina-bi yende ko l’eoka yanu, mbo booto wa Mungu ebotoɔlwa ndotumesa likama lia bato, boulweseke bootaota wa liineli lioomalesa Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

lokele: Eokao toitowa esole, ango bindo ebisɔɛnɛlɛ bisosɛɛsɛlɛ, nde botema ebotiɛnɛlɛ botoaelesomo bofoka boyai lise la lise.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

lokele: Eoka bifembi ebisowaka lasu kwani bieshelaka nd’iso konda layalaya ambɔlɛ wa liomala eliti liokwelomo,
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

lokele: eoka toitowɛlɛ yeka ebisɔɛnɛlɛ bonono, kangä yeka ebiitɔɛnɛlɛ, litina mbo ebisɔɛnɛlɛ bitoumwaka ko mbile sinyo kongo, nde ebiitɔɛnɛlɛ la baiso bende yao ebilakataka layalaya.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

lokele: Eingo, toluwi nde mbo ango kumbo eyesoyael’iso nda wenda-bo, eukwaka, limɔ iso koyalaka la ndakɔ angɛnɛ eyesoswomo la Mungu, eyetiswomo la besamba, nde ndakɔ eyetoyalaka layalaya nda Use.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

lokele: Eoka ani ayal’iso nda kumbo ono, totosumaka la yɛmɛ yoobiamelomo la ndakɔ ena ya Use,
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

lokele: mbo akalinjomoko iso la yao, iso angooshomo ko wase.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

lokele: Akoyal’iso nda kumbo ya bindo yasu, tososumaka eoka ya bolito wa botema, inga eoka mbo tolɛmbi ndosokoelomo kumbo-ye, kangä ndolinjakomo mbo ena eyekaweke kofangolomo la eyɛmɔi eyekayaleke la loiko.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

lokele: Inde oyasokuwel’iso nda loasɔ-lo ale Mungu angɛnɛ, Oyasof’iso Bolimo kwa tukä ya lisakä liande.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

lokele: Tosoyaimwa to la lilendelu la mbile bitotina ani tosoluwa mbo bindo yasu bile ko kumbo yasu ya lɔkɛndɔ ani asosiama iso sia la Ngɛnɛ;
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

lokele: tosokɛkɛ kɛndɔ yasu ko la liimeli, angotɛnɛ kɔni mboka la baiso.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

lokele: Nde tosoyaimwa nda betema yasu la tosotalɛmbɛ ndosiama la bindo-bi la ndokayala olo eyasu ende Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

lokele: Eokao, ango toyala amamwito lande, ango toyala esika kwa bɛɛnda, tosolɛmbɛ finɛ ko ndoomalesa Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

lokele: Eoka lole lasu, yaatotina ndoemala nda kɛka ya likɔmanyi lia Masiya, mbo boto la boto aɔlɛkɛ liɔli lioengana la bekeeli eyakelak’inde ono nda bindo, ango ko bolau ango ko bobe. Boyaeli wa Botomomu wa Yesu Masiya
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

lokele: Eokao, asoluwa iso oluwa mbo Ngɛnɛ wasu ale owangomo, tosotinjaka bato mbo balendeloko; Mungu nd’aluwi kwa ayal’iso la iyɛli shami sile mbo ino nda betema yanu oluwi imɔ koluwa lisanga.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

lokele: Totiongel’iso angɛnɛ liasi, kongo ko tosof’ino fofe yoomalaka loasɔ loasu, mbo ino wɛnɛkɛ fofe yomutoel’iyo ebatoomalaka loasɔ loa wɛnɛɛli wa boto inga loasɔ loa botema wande.
english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

lokele: Eoka towa loseka, ambo ko loasɔ loa Mungu, ango toyala la wɛlï, ambo ko l’eoka yanu.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

lokele: Eoka losamɔ loa Masiya losotinjak’iso; la kwa asotang’iso ongoma mbo Ɔmɔi asowela batoti, ongoma to batotina basowa ndowa.
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

lokele: Inde asowela batotina, mbo batoti ebasowawa batayalëk’imɔ ko l’eoka yau angɛnɛ, kangä l’eoka ya Inde oyawelak’iyo la oyatɛmwaka nda liwa.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

lokele: Eokao to, toitoluw’imɔ boto ko loasɔ loa bindo; la ango twaluwaka Masiya oso ko loasɔ loa bindo, iso angotang’Inde ongoma imɔ liasi.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

lokele: Ongoma to, boto eyala wa Masiya, asoyala boto wa boyaeli boyai; ewa oso bososokwasokwa, bosokinjwa to boyai!
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, 5:17 all things have become new.

lokele: Bitotina-bi bisoya end’iso ko la booto wa Mungu oyasootwanes’iso la Inde angɛnɛ liasi ko eoka ya Masiya la asof’iso isosha sha likuwa-li liotwanesi lia bato la Mungu;
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

lokele: mbo Mungu ayalaka la Yesu ndootwanesa eba wenda lande angɛnɛ, angotang’imɔ batwanelo bau, nde asof’iso wɛndi-bo wa liotwanesi lia bato.
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

lokele: Eokao iso twende tokomya nda loasɔ loa Masiya, Mungu atotaka boeki ko la bɔnɔkɔ wasu. Iso tosolɔmbɔkɔlɔk’ino nda lifa lia Masiya mbo otwananeke la Mungu liasi.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

lokele: Yesu atialuwaka litwanelo ango limɔi, nde Mungu lotang’Inde mbo ewa batwanelo ko l’eoka yasu bato, mbo iso bato tokinjweke eba liengani nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

lokele: Ongoma to iso ebasokelana la Masiya elikuwa-li, tosolɔmbɔkɔl’ino mbo wɔlɛ̈kɛ booto wa Mungu liɔlɛlɛ, eoka Inde loonga mbo—
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

lokele: Nda fofe yɔɔlɛlɛ, isolail’aɛ, La nda lise lia liuwesi isoyasung’aɛ. Tɛnɛngo, kwani ele fofe yɔlɔkɔ booto, Tɛnɛ to louse-lo lise lia liuwesi!
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Isaiah 49:8 Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

lokele: Totikufese boto angɔmɔi ango sinyo mbo likuwa-li litafomo liɛngɔ.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

lokele: Kongo ko iso ebatokuwela Mungu tosokota ndoengana la wɛlï nda likuwa; ko la likɔkɔmɛlɛ eliti la itɔɔ, la nda bifembi, la nda baömä,
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

lokele: la nda bakuchomu, nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, nda besho, nda bonui, la botengu wa bocho, la nda londo;
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

lokele: ko la botanu wa bekeeli, nda liluwanesi lia Bolimo, nda bofiili, la bɔfɔɔmu, la nda booto; nda bolimo botanu, la losamɔ eloti la bolimbake;
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

lokele: la nda lioi lia momongo, nda bofoka wa Mungu; la biɛla ya liengani nda bosamba wa olome la nda bosamba wa wali;
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

lokele: la loliteso lolau la nda sɔni, la lokuku lobe la nda lokuku lolau imɔ. Tosotangomo mbo tolimbichɔli, nde twende eba momongo;
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

lokele: bamɔi angoluw’iso ango sinyo, nde basi basoluwana lasu la wɛlï, tosotangomo mbo ebasambowa; nde tɛnɛngo tokowawa; tosokuchomo, nde totiolomo;
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

lokele: tosowa ikɛnɛnɛ, nde mbile la mbile tosoomala la limɛngɔ; twende touwe nde totofotekesa bato wike; toti ango la shaya, nde tososɛlɛ yeka bitotina.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

lokele: Ee, ino BaKolinto, isoasoel’ino bɔnɔkɔ wami la botema wami bole fololo nda baiso banu;
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

lokele: betema yanu bitisɔlɔnɛsɔmɔ ko lasu, nde ino angɛnɛ ososɔlɔnɛsɛ betema yanu!
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

lokele: Inoelaka to’mi ko ongoma, kelaka kwa bana bami, faloelaka’mi betema yanu imɔ! Oyalëke lisaɔ la boto oyati la liimeli lia Masiya
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

lokele: Wakolëke ndowatemana la bato basi ebatiimele Ngɛnɛ; ¿Liengani la litefoli lia Bikela batosangana to nda lini likaɔ? ¿Linyanya la lilima batosangana la moni?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

lokele: ¿Lini likulyani lisoyala la Masiya la Satana? ¿Boto wa liimeli, la oyatiimele kosukana la lini to lisaɔ?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

lokele: ¿Eyaelo ya Mungu la bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu kokuliana la moni? Eoka iso nd’ayali to eyaelo ya Mungu wa liwawi, kwa aongaka Mungu angɛnɛ mbo— Itoyalaka lau la itokɛndɛkɛndɛ sisi yau, Itoyala ewau Mungu, la iyo batoyala ebami bato.
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.” Leviticus 26:12

lokele: Eokao, Mungu loonga mbo— Sokwaka sisi yau, sɛnyanaka lau, Omatëke boto oyatitane, limɔ Imi nd’atoaela ino.
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you. Isaiah 52:11

lokele: Itoyala kwa Sango end’ino la ino koyala kwa bana bami Batolome la batomali, Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa Bofoka asoonga ongoma.
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.” 2 Samuel 7:14

lokele: Ino ebasamomu lami, ani afomoko iso e-basakä-ba, totaneseke to betema yasu ndosokokola bɔwɛwɛ bototina wa bindo l’ewa botema lisanga, la tükameseke betema yasu uka ende Mungu la lilitesi la bɔwa.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

lokele: Faefaka iso elela nda betema yanu, totikeele boto angɔmɔi wanu bobe, totibebeseke boto angɔmɔi, la totilimbake boto angɔmɔi.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

lokele: Itionge ani ndof’ino se; mba, isotaonga oso mbo ino wende nda betema yasu mbo towatemeke nda liwa la nda liwawi imɔ.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

lokele: Itokambes’ino fololo mbo isotendela ndoomala loasɔ loanu, botema wami bosoaa se suu la bosotuma fuu la lilatemi loasɔ loanu; isoyaimwa yai ani ayali’mi la bifembi imɔ wike. Loyo loa Tito bosungi wa Paulo
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

lokele: Eoka ayak’iso nda Makedonia bindo yasu bitiaɛumaka ango sinyo, kangä ko bifembi ya bɛfɔnɔ bitotina, bita la bosho lousa la bɔwa nda botema.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

lokele: Kongo ko Inde oyatɔɔngɛsɛ eba betema ya bolito, ako Mungu, Inde nd’aɔngɛsɛkɛ betema yasu eoka ya loyo loa Tito end’iso;
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

lokele: inga loasɔ loa loyo kongo, kangä imɔ loasɔ loa liɔngɛsi la limɛngɔ elisok’inde end’ino la asoluwes’inde oluwesa iso eniya yanu, la ngandi eyokak’ino la yɛmɛ yanu yosungak’mi, eokao im’isooka limɛngɔ finɛ.
english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

lokele: Ango yeokesak’ino botema wale nda lokasa lona loami, nde kwani itiok’imɔ ikɛnɛnɛ ani yokaka ikɛnɛnɛ nda loao oso, eoka isɔɛnɛ mbo lokasa lona loafak’ino botema wale finɛ, ambo ko mbile sinyo kongo.
english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

lokele: Kwani isoka limɛngɔ, inga to eoka ya wale ewokak’ino, kangä eoka mbo wakalanganaka eoka ya wale wa betema yanu; wokaka nde wale ewaeshaka Mungu la ongoma otibebesomo ko loasɔ loasu.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

lokele: Botema wale ebososokwa ende Mungu botoesha likalangani elitofɔɔlɔ liuwesi, likalangani liitoesha ikɛnɛnɛ, kongo ko botema wale ebole la eba wenda-bo botofɔɔlɔ liwa angɛnɛ.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

lokele: Tɛnɛ to botema wale ebosoeshel’ino Mungu, mbo bosɔɔlɛs’ino bofiili, aina yɛmɛ yosokola loasɔ nda lokomba, aina lisomi liosoma la bobe, aina bɔwa ndowanga Mungu, aina yɛmɛ ya booto, aina bafumba bokucha bɔfɔɔli wa obe! Nda loasɔ lototina osɔɛnɛsɛ mbo ot’imɔ se nda loao mbo otikulye bɔfɔɔli.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

lokele: Nde ambo yasɔnɔkɔ lokasa end’ino, inga mbo boto ona w’obe akuchomoko, inga loasɔ loa boto ona oyakelomoko obe, kangä mbo yɛmɛ yanu yokɔkɔmɔ nda likuwa liasu liɛnɛlɛkɛ fololo, yasɔnɔkɔ ongoma ko nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

lokele: Eokao tososungakomo lanu. Nde tososungakomo imɔ liasi eoka ya bootaota wa Tito mbo botema wande angɛnɛ bosɔɔngɔ loasɔ loanu yaatotina.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

lokele: Kwa asoomala’mi loasɔ loanu nda batoi ba Tito, ongoma kwa baoi bami end’ino bende wewe, ongoma to loomalo loasu ende Tito eoka yanu lole imɔ ko wewe.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

lokele: Botema wande bosofɛfɛ la losamɔ end’ino ani asoenyakela lilitesi lianu la bɔwa la linyangi ebiɛnɛk’inde omolo eyanu.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

lokele: Isoyaimwa la limɛngɔ eoka isokɔkɔlɔ ndolendelo ino nda njasɔ bitotina.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

lokele: Bitungani yami, iluwesek’ino loasɔ loa bootaota wa Mungu ebosɔɛnɛlɛ nda bitanda nda Makedonia, boko mbo basokusokola lifaefi liosunga basi,
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

lokele: la mbo nda mbile ya bifembi ebisokɔtɔl’iyo, limɛngɔ elisok’iyo ango nda mbuwa yau, lisoelwaka likama nda lifaefi lifi elisofaef’iyo ko lifaefela.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

lokele: Imi angɛnɛ nd’asoaola mbo basokusokola lifaefi litotina elisokɔkɔl’iyo, ango ndoeta likaɔ elioengana, ko la lisangi eliau angɛnɛ;
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

lokele: la iyo basolɔmbɔkɔlɔ’mi la bofiili mbo yɔlɛsɛk’iyo bootaota wowatema la ebatokusola lifaefi liosunga bato ba Etanda ebale la beeno.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

lokele: Batikusole ko yao ebienyel’iso kongo, kangä eyoeta eoka basotafa Mungu betema yau amamwito la losamɔ end’iso kwa asosanga Mungu angɛnɛ;
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

lokele: ongoma tosofela Tito mbo asileke ndosɔnjaka lifaefi lianu lia booto eoka inde nd’asoakola ndosɔnja liao.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

lokele: Kongo ko kwa asɔɔlwa ino nda njasɔ bitotina bilau, la liimeli, la linangoli, la liluwani la boliliya nda bakuwa batotina, la losamɔ loanu losamak’iso, bolau mbo ɔlwɛkɛ imɔ nda likuwa-li lia bootaota lisanga.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

lokele: Ongoma itit’ino ekela, mba, kongo ko, eoka ya boliliya wa bato basi isolɛmbɛ ndotamba basi mbo losamɔ loanu lole nde wewe.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

lokele: Eoka oluwi nde booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, mbo kwa ayalak’Inde la lifoka lioeta fafo, Inde lokinjwa mbuwa eoka yasu, mbo ino angɛnɛ boyalakeke bafoka ko la mbuwa yande.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

lokele: Isoluwes’ino kwa asoenyela’mi mbo loengani nde lanu ndosilesa loasɔ-lo elosokel’ino la elososang’imɔ ino nda mwaka wa oso.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

lokele: Ongoma to, kwani ɔlɔlɔkɔ ndokelaka ongoma kwa asosang’ino la bofiili ko la yeka ebisosɛl’ino.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

lokele: Eoka boto esanga loasɔ la bofiili, ambo lole ko la yeka ebisosɛl’inde, inga ko la yao ebitisɛl’inde.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

lokele: Inga to mbo basi basungomoko ko l’eoka ya bifembi yanu, kangä ko la bɔfɔnɔ wa likelemba eliengani,
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

lokele: liko mbo nda mbile-ye kwani, lilya lianu litosilesa boeno wau, limɔ lilya liau litosilesa boeno wanu, ongoma to likelemba litoengana,
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

lokele: kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa loa Mungu mbo— Oyatwaka eula efi, angoyala la lilya; la oyatwaka ko sinyo, angoomelo.
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.” Exodus 16:18

lokele: Kelekele to ende Mungu oyasofa imɔ ko Tito boliliya-bo wosungak’ino,
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

lokele: mbo inde asokulya lioi liami la limɛngɔ, nde inde angɛnɛ asoya end’ino la lisangi liande angɛnɛ.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

lokele: Tosotoma oto wasi amamwito lande, ako etungani ena oyasoinelomo mbo Bonangoli bolau wa Mboli Ilau nda bitanda bitotina;
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

lokele: la oyasokulyomo imɔ la bitanda mbo akɛsɛnɛkɛ lasu nda kɛndɔ yasu nda likaeli lia lifaefi lia booto, eoka ya loinelo loa Ngɛnɛ wasu la ndoendesa imɔ likuwa liasu,
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

lokele: eoka mbo boto ataf’iso liɛngɔ loasɔ loa lifaefi lia bofäfü elitokael’iso,
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

lokele: eoka tosotakela bolenda loasɔ loa lokuku lolau loasu nda baiso ba Ngɛnɛ l’eba bato lisanga.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

lokele: Tosotoma imɔ etungani yasu amamwito lau eoka tosokɔtɔl’inde mbile wike la tosɔɛn’inde boto wa boliliya finɛ nda njasɔ wike la kwani imɔ boliliya wande bosoetaka eoka ya lilendelu liande loasɔ loanu.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

lokele: Bofela loasɔ loa Tito, ale ko bosungi la bokuwani lami okuwel’ino; bofela loasɔ loa bitungani yasu ebimɔi, bende ebasotomomo la wɛndi wa Bitanda la liomala lia Masiya.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

lokele: Ɛnɛsɛkɛ to iyo, nda baiso ba eba bitanda, mbo losamɔ loanu lole wewe la mbo liineli liasu loasɔ loanu ende ebato-ba lile wewe imɔ.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

lokele: Nde nda loasɔ loa lifaefi liosunga bato ba Etanda ebale la boeno, ino otienu mbo isɔnɛlɛk’ino liasi,
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

lokele: eoka iluwi nde mbo okulyi nde finɛ, kwa asoinakel’mi ino ende eba Makedonia mbo— Eba Akaiya basokomya okusola ko nda mwaka wa oso; eingo, bofiili wanu bosofumbesa wike wau.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

lokele: Isotatoma to e-bitungani-bi mbo baoi bami boinel’ino batayala ko baoi wawa nda loasɔ-lo, kangä mbo boenganeke ndosɔnja liao kwa aongaka’mi,
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

lokele: mbo eluwa bamɔi ba Makedonia ebatoya amamwito lami, bataosh’ino ani okakomyi lisɔnji lia lifaefi la ongoma iso kofomo sɔni, asa kɔni ino lisanga, eoka ya baoi ba liomala lina.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

lokele: Eokao itangi nde mbo, bolau mbo ilɔmbɔkɔlɛkɛ bitungani-bi mbo batakɛndɛkɛ end’ino ndokakɔmya lisɔnji lia lifaefi elisotik’ino lisakä liokusokola liao, nde basɔnjɛ̈ke liao kwa bɔsɔmbi, kangä kwa lifaefi lia losamɔ.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

lokele: Enyelaka to lioi-li mbo— Oyatolɔɔ koto la wima, etwaka eula ko ɛkɛkɛ; la oyatolɔɔ koto iyongoongo, etwaka imɔ ko likama.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

lokele: Boto la boto akusoleke kwa asosang’inde nda botema wande inga l’ikɛnɛnɛ la mbo asotinjakomo, eoka Mungu nd’asami inde oyatofaefa lifaefi la bootaota.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

lokele: Mungu atokɔkɔlɔ ndɔɔlɔlɔ bootaota bolau bototina end’ino mbo ko mbile bitotina osɛlɛkɛ lilya lia yeka bitotina, limɔ okusokoleke lifaefi liosungaka bakuwa batotina balau.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

lokele: Kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa loa Mungu, mbo— Atomelekesa bafaefi, atofaekefa ende eba touwe; Ongoma liengani lilau liande litotikala layalaya.
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.” Psalms 112:9

lokele: Limɔ Inde oyatofaefa bɔlɔi koto la lituma liola, efaefak’ino yeka yolɔɔ la yokondaka la eulwesaka eyanu eula ya liengani.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

lokele: Ongoma otofotesomo ko la bitotina, limɔ lifaefi lianu elitokaelomo lasu, litoɔlɛsɛ ebatofomo liao ko kelekele ende Mungu,
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

lokele: eoka likuwa-li lia lisungani litosilesa beeno ya beoto ya Etanda, nde litoelwaka ko ndoyaimwesa Mungu eoka ya kelekele end’Inde.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

lokele: Atoluw’iyo oluwa lisungi lianu, limɔ batoinakela Mungu eoka ya lilitesi lianu liolitesa bikela ya Mboli Ilau ya Masiya la eoka ya likaɔ lianu end’iyo la ende batotina;
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

lokele: la iyo ana batosombola loasɔ loanu la batosamak’ino finɛ ko l’eoka ya booto wa Mungu eboetaka nda bekeli yanu.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

lokele: Kelekele finɛ ende Mungu loasɔ loa lifaefi liande eliti liosanoelomo la baoi!
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

lokele: Imi angɛnɛ ako Paulo, isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino la liikami se la botema sambo wa Masiya, imi oyasoyala la liɔndwi se oso wanu, nde oyasoyala la boendu ani ayali’mi esika lanu; bamɔi batoonga ongoma to;
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

lokele: imi to nd’asolɔmbɔkɔl’ino mbo otatinjaka’mi ndoyatamb’ino lotendela loami ani akayaleke’mi lanu, ko lotendela lona elototamba’mi otamba bato ana ebatoenyela mbo twende ebatokɛndɛsɔmɔ ko la yɛmɛ ya bindo.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

lokele: Totokɛndɛkɛndɛ ono nda bindo nde toitonana bita la bonaneli wa bindo,
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

lokele: biɛla to ebitonana lasu, biti ya balomboki, nde bile la bofoka wa Mungu angɛnɛ ndosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ bakula bafi ba bita,
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

lokele: ndokwesa baasala ba balomboki la tofenya twa bɔmɛtɔ etosofenya liluwani lia Mungu, ndoundesa baenya batotina kakaa la ndokakalesa bao ende Masiya, bako ebatilitese Inde,
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

lokele: ndokɔkɔmɔ mbo tokucheke litefoli litotina, ko ani elianu lilitesi lisɔɔlwa.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

lokele: Ototicha ko yao ebile fololo oso wa baiso banu! Ango boto koimela wewe mbo inde angɛnɛ ale wa Masiya, ataenyelaka liasi nda botema mbo kwa ayal’inde wa Masiya, ko iso imɔ ko ongoma.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

lokele: Eoka ango yeomala sumbu loasɔ loa isosha shasu esisofomo ko la Ngɛnɛ wasu ndokɔkɔmɛs’ino, inga ndokwes’ino se, ani imi angofomo sɔni;
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

lokele: mbo italɛmbɛ ndowaes’ino ko la kasa-bi ebisɔniki’mi end’ino.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

lokele: Eoka bamɔi mbo— Kasa ebitosɔnɔk’inde yende biwaü la bofoka finɛ, kongo ko atɔɛnɛ iso wɛnɛ boyaeli wande, bole ko la bɔlɛmbu la boongeli wande bɔlɛlɛmu imɔ.
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

lokele: Oyatoonga ani, ataenyelaka liölo-li mbo, kwa ayali nde’mi ani atosɔnɔ’mi lokasa ko esika lanu, yende ko la bɔfɔnɔ-ao nda bekeeli ani yende sisi yanu. Paulo angoeteela isosha sha Mungu esifomu end’inde
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

lokele: Iso angotendela to ndosakana la ndokweekelana boyaeli wami la boyaeli wa bato ana ebatoinakelaka boyaeli wau angɛnɛ. Atokweekelana iyo, la atosakana iyo angɛnɛ, bati ango la liluwani.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

lokele: Nde toitofaala la isosha shoeta esisokweelomo’iso, kongo ko tosolitesa liko elisokweelomo iso la Mungu, la isosha esisoobiamel’imɔ ko ino.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

lokele: Totieteele ino oso, kwa mbo totiyel’ino; iso nd’ayali eba oso ndoiyel’ino la Mboli Ilau ya Masiya.
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

lokele: Toitofaala finɛ loasɔ loa bonui wa likuwa lia bato basi, kongo ko tosɔkɛsɛ iɛli mbo, akaulweke liimeli lianu, ko ongoma tukela olo atokuwel’iso kosɛngɛ;
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

lokele: mbo tonangoleke Mboli Ilau nda yese ebile fangi yasi yanu, kongo ko iso angoomala l’ifaala loasɔ loa likuwa elisokelomo la tukela ya boto wasi.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

lokele: Kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Oyatoomala, aomaleke ko l’eoka ya Ngɛnɛ!
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” Jeremiah 9:24

lokele: Boto oyasokuliomo ati to inde oyatoinela lokuku loande angɛnɛ, kangä boto oyasoinelomo la Ngɛnɛ.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

lokele: Bomɛsɛlɛkɛ’mi sumbu nda baölo-ba ebati la wɛlï! Eingo, talɛmbɛkɛ’mi yongeke,
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

lokele: eoka isookel’ino losamɔ kwa eloa Mungu ndüch’ino; isosɔngɛs’ino ende Masiya mbo itambeke ino ende bolome ɔmwito, kwa boseka oyati la loasɔ.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

lokele: Nde isowanga mbo otalimbomo kwa alimbomoko Ewa ko la bɔlɔwanɛ wa Njɔ, la mbo betema yanu imɔ bitaengolomo ndomacha losamɔ loanu losamaka Masiya la momongo la lilendelu.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

lokele: Nde boto wasi eya ndoyanangola Yesu wa boyaeli wasi, inga wao ewanangolak’iso, la waɔlɔkɔ Bolimo wasi ebotiɔl’ino oso, ango wakuliaka Mboli Ilau yasi ebitiokek’ino end’iso, ambo ino koimel’inde la olau!
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

lokele: Itangi nde mbo im’iti mbisa ya ebatomomu ana ba lokuku, ango sinyo.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

lokele: Ango yeyela ebebe angoluwa ndoonga, kongo ko imi angoomelo liluwani la isoluwes’ino yaatotina e-njasɔ-bi bitotina ko fololo.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

lokele: ¿Mbo isotwanelo to eoka mbo yaikamaka se, ko mbo ino otalemeke likolo? ¿Litwanelo mbo yanangoelak’ino Mboli Ilau ya Mungu ko wawa, angɔɔsɔ bieto yanu?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

lokele: Yaɔlɔkɔ bieto kwa wiya ende bitanda yasi mbo isombeke bieka yola mbo ikuweleke ko ino.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

lokele: Limɔ ayalaka’mi eyanu nda Kolinto, yaenoko bieka yola, nde itiayalaka la bolito ende boto angɔmɔi wanu, eoka bitungani ya Makedonia lɔɔlɛsɛ’mi yao ebisoeno ani ayak’iyo ono. Itiayalaka to bolito end’ino ango sinyo, la kwani imɔ iitoyala bolito end’ino.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

lokele: Wewe wa Masiya bole lami la lole wewe mbo loomalo-lo loami loitokufa ndookana nda yese etotina ya Akaiya.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

lokele: ¿Eok’iye to? ¿Mbo itisam’ino wewe? Mungu angɛnɛ nd’aluwi mbo isami nd’ino!
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

lokele: Nde elosokela’mi, yekelaka ngo ko ongoma, litina mbo itafaef’iyo fofe mbo bataosha fofe yoomala kwa asoomala iso.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

lokele: Bato ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo bati batomomu wewe, bende basali ba bolimbake, batokweekela boyaeli wa Batomomu ba Masiya.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

lokele: Siti to ilombo, eoka Satana imɔ atokweekela bokitomo wa löwa.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

lokele: Loti to loasɔ lomwaala mbo basungi bande kokweekela ebatosungaka Ngɛnɛ wa liengani. Lotungamo loau lotoengana la bekeeli yau!
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

lokele: Itoonga liasi mbo— Boto atatanga’mi ebebe; nde botanga’mi ongoma, okaka’mi sumbu kwa atookomo ebebe, mbo yomaleke l’ifaala sumbu, imɔ ko’mi.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

lokele: Elitoonga’mi kwani, iitoonga liao l’isosha sha Ngɛnɛ, kangä kwa mbo ebebe ya boto ani isolendelo ifaala-si;
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

lokele: ango bato wike kofaala loasɔ loa boyaeli nda wenda-bo, ambo imɔ ko imi nd’atofaala.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

lokele: Ko la limɛngɔ ino nd’atolaila eba ebebe eoka ino wende la wɛlï finɛ!
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

lokele: Ino otolaila to iyo ani batosɛl’ino bɛkɔwa yau, ani batolaka yeka yanu, ani batolimbak’ino la shɔngɔlɔ, ani batotambak’ino lɔfɔlɔ, la ani batotefwesa biɔmbɔ yanu.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

lokele: Isoaola loasɔ-lo la sɔni, kwa mbo twende bilɛli ya bato. Kongo ko ango betendela ndoomala l’ifaala nda loasɔ lɔmɔi, ambo imɔ ko imi nd’atotendela ongoma. Nde atoonga’mi wa, yende ko ebebe! Bifembi la tɔkɛnɛnɛ ya Paulo angɛnɛ
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

lokele: ¿Bende BaYuda? Imi imɔ ko ongoma. ¿Bende bana ba Isalaele? La imi imɔ. ¿Bende ba bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Abalayama? La imi imɔ.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring 11:22 of Abraham? So am I.

lokele: ¿Bende bakuweli ba Masiya? Isoonga kwani loseka; simbi to’mi yende bokuweli wa Masiya. Isoetel’iyo fwaa, la nda bonui wa bakuwa wike, la nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ mbile la mbile, isokuchakomo likama, isowa imɔ bawa wike.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

lokele: Mbile ko bɔɔmwi, BaYuda loomaka’mi baoma kama inɛi, koomelo lioma limɔi;
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

lokele: mbile ko isato imi lonyɔlɔmɔkɔ la tɔnyɔli; mbile ɛmɔi imi lokushakomo batalɛ; mbile bisatɔ watɔ wa lofofo ewayalaka’mi lolinda, la löwa la ocho imi locha nda balia ba olundu;
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

lokele: nda kɛndɔ wike angoɛuma, la bifembi eoka ya fela, bifembi eoka ya eba wiya, eoka ya bato ba tukela yami angɛnɛ, la eoka ya bato ba biese yasi, bifembi nda ngima ya okenge, la nda liɔmbɛlɛ, la nda balia ba bokwa, bifembi eoka ya bato ebalimbakelaka’mi mbo eba liimeli;
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

lokele: nda bonui la likati lia likuwa, nda litenga la ocho, la isiyɛ sha bieka la yɛmɛ yomwa, la fondo wike, la nda bɔfɛfyɔ la boeno wa bisinda yowata,
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

lokele: la yasi imɔ ebititomo, limɔ isowamakomo lise la lise ko la ikɛnɛnɛ sha bifembi ya bitanda bitotina.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

lokele: ¿Ndai to ale la bɔlɛmbu, ani imi angok’imɔ ko bɔlɛmbu? ¿Ndai to atokwesomo ilango, ani imi angosoma eoka yande?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

lokele: Ango engani nde mbo yongeke la ifaala, ambo ko loasɔ loa bɔlɛmbu wami elotofaala’mi.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

lokele: Mungu angɛnɛ, Sango wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu, oyatoinakelomo layalaya, Inde asoluwa mbo itite lolanga.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

lokele: Nda Damaseke Komanda wa Bɔkɔta Aleta alambaka biome ya bokenge wa Damaseke mbo aundeseke’mi;
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

lokele: kongo ko imi losulolomo se ko la lililisa lia ndakɔ nda likula lia batalɛ, nda bofalo, la ongoma imi lolɔmwa nda besamba yande.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

lokele: Ango yeomala l’ifaala, shao angɔɔlɛsɛ’mi olau; itɔkɛ la oso okaluwes’ino loasɔ loa liɛni la lɔɛnɛsɔmu loa Ngɛnɛ eyɛnɛlɛkɛ ende’mi.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

lokele: Iluwi nde boto oyaundomoko la bofoka wa Masiya, kwani miaka liu la inɛi bisoeta; elua ayalaka bolomboki, elua atiayalaka la bindo yande, itiluwe, kangä Mungu angɛnɛ nd’aluwi, nde aundomoko inde ongoma la Masiya, inde loilomo likolo konda buse wa isatɔ.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

lokele: Iluwi imɔ mbo boto-ao, elua ayalaka bolomboki, elua atiayalaka la bindo yande, itiluwe, kangä Mungu angɛnɛ nd’aluwi, nde inde loilomo konda Paladiso.
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

lokele: Limɔ inde looka baoi ebati boongomo, bati bosingwomo la bɔnɔkɔ wa boto.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

lokele: Itoomala l’ifaala loasɔ loa boto-ao, kongo ko iitoomala l’ifaala loasɔ loami angɛnɛ sakolo ngo ko loasɔ loa bɔlɛmbu ebole lami.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

lokele: Ango yesanga ndoomala, imi angoyala ebebe eoka itoonga ko wewe. Nde itokufa ndoonga mbo boto atatanga nde boyaeli wami bosolongela wao ebosɔɛn’inde la bosok’inde ende’mi;
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

lokele: limɔ eoka ya ambɔlɛ wa lɔɛnɛsɔmɔ, mbo itaomala finɛ, yafomoko bakɛ̈kɛ wa lowelo finɛ nda lokomba loami, botomomu wa Satana wolukaka’mi bofi mbo itaomala likama.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

lokele: Yasombolaka Ngɛnɛ basombola basatɔ nda loasɔ-lo, mbo asokoeleke’mi wao;
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

lokele: nde Inde loonga lami mbo— Booto wami boengani nde laɛ, eoka bofoka wami bosɔɔlwa ko nda bɔlɛmbu waɛ. Ongoma to yende la limɛngɔ ndoomala loasɔ loa bɔlɛmbu wami, mbo bofoka wa Masiya boobyameleke’mi kwa losambɔ.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

lokele: Eoka ya Masiya to isoyala la limɛngɔ nda botema imɔ ko la bɔlɛmbu, la bɔfi la bifembi, la likongolomu, la baömä; eoka atoyala’mi la bɔlɛmbu, kwaamao yende la bofoka finɛ.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

lokele: Isokinjwa kwa ebebe, nde ino nd’asotinjaka’mi. Loengani nde lanu ndoongela’mi ende basi eoka im’iti mbisa ya batomomu ana ba lokuku, ango sinyo; ambo iti yeka wewe.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

lokele: Kongo ko ndembe ya Batomomu angɛnɛ bisɔɛnɛlɛ ani bisokelomo sisi yanu la bofiili ko la ndembe la bisisho la tokesa.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

lokele: ¿Watangomoko nde mbo otiengane la bitanda ebimɔi nda loni to loasɔ, sakolo ko mbo imi angɛnɛ itiyaleke bolito end’ino? Mɛsɛlɛkɛ to’mi nda litwanelo-li!
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, litonji lia asatɔ elikotonja’mi lɔkɛndɔ loami loya fɛtɛti end’ino; itiayale bolito end’ino eoka itiluke yeka yanu kangä betema yanu. Eoka bana baitosɔnjɛlɛ ebaot’iyo bieto, kangä sango la nyango nd’atosɔnjela bana bau.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

lokele: Ongoma to imi nd’atomelesa bieto yami la limɛngɔ la liwawi liami imɔ eoka ya betema yanu. ¿Yesamak’ino la losamɔ loeta, mbo ino kosama nde’mi la losamɔ lɔmyɔ?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

lokele: Loyaleke to ongoma, nde bamɔi mbo imi angɛnɛ itiyaleke bolito end’ino, kongo ko isolimbakel’ino la shɔngɔlɔ esiyali lami!
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

lokele: ¿Mbo isolimbak’ino ko ndolola yeka yanu ko la bato ana ebasotoma’mi otomel’ino?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

lokele: Yafelaka Tito ndoya end’ino fɛtɛti la etungani yasi imɔ amamwito lande; ¿Mbo Tito asolimbak’ino i? ¿Iso lande toisokɛndɛkɛndɛ la botema ɔmwito? Iso lande toisokɛndɛkɛndɛ cha ko la mboka ko ɛmwito? Boimo wa Paulo oso wa lɔkɛndɔ loande
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

lokele: ¿Otangi nde mbo baoi-ba wike bende ko ndomutoel’ino tofenya? Nde tosoonga kwa mbo oso wa Mungu la isosha sha Masiya, la baoi batotina bende ko loasɔ loanu, ebasamomu lami, mbo ikɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ ino.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

lokele: Iwangi nde mbo itaya oyaosh’ino la boyaeli ebotilɛmbɛ’mi la mbo ino angoosha’mi angɛnɛ la boyaeli ebosolɛmb’ino; iwangi nde mbo itaosh’ino la liwesani, la liya, la efango la tochocho, litɔngwi la bolao, bɔmɛtɔ la lieyaeyi.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

lokele: Isowanga mbo, akayeke’mi liasi, Mungu atachambola’mi loasɔ loanu la mbo itawa ikɛnɛnɛ eoka yanu wike ba batwanelo ebasow’iyo angotakalangana kɔni, bako bɔwɛwɛ la nyongo la bolëfë ebisotwak’iyo.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

lokele: Lisanga lia asatɔ-li elisosanga’mi ndoya fɛtɛti end’ino. Nda Lokasa loasɔnɔmɔkɔ mbo— Baölo batotina batokɔkɔmɛsɔmɔ ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya baɛni basatɔ kwa bambale.
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.” Deuteronomy 19:15

lokele: Isotakambes’ebayalaka la njasɔ la isokambes’iyo kwani ko liasi ani iti lanu, kwa aongaka’mi nda lɔkɛndɔ loa imbale ani yayalaka lanu, mbo yeya liasi imi angomacha njasɔ ina la njasɔ ebimɔi imɔ;
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

lokele: eoka otikulye mbo Masiya atoonga la bɔnɔkɔ wami sakolo ngo ko wɛnɛ ndembe; kongo ko Masiya ati la bɔlɛmbu end’ino kangä la bofoka wa likama.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

lokele: Nde awaka nda lieka ko la bɔlɛmbu, kongo ko kwani ale la loiko ko la bofoka wa Mungu angɛnɛ. Iso imɔ ko ongoma, twende lande la bɔlɛmbu, kongo ko tosoyala la loiko amamwito lande ko la bofoka wa Mungu angɛnɛ nda likomyi lia loasɔ loanu.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

lokele: Kɔtɔlɔkɔ betema yanu angɛnɛ oluweke kwa mbo osokɔkɔmɔ nda liimeli; lembeelaka njasɔ yanu angɛnɛ. ¿Otiluwe to mbo Masiya ale nde lanu? Elua otikuliomo to mbo wengani.
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

lokele: Yenyeli nde mbo otolembeela mbo iso tosokɔkɔmɔ nda likɔtɔli.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

lokele: Nde tososombokola Mungu mbo otakela obe ango sinyo, inga to mbo iso twɛnɛlɛkɛ kwa ebasolonga nda likɔtɔli, kangä mbo ino bokɛndɛlɛkɛ la mboka elau, ani iso tosɔɛnɛlɛ kwa ebasofomo se nda likɔtɔli.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

lokele: Totikɔkɔkɔlɛ ndokufesa njasɔ ya wewe, kangä ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ wewe.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

lokele: Tosooka limɛngɔ ani iso tole la bɔlɛmbu ani ino nd’asokɔkɔmɔ la bofoka. Lisomboli liasu lile ngo ko mbo wenganesomoko cha.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’ino la baoi-ba ani akoyali’mi esika lanu, mbo eyekayeke’mi end’ino, itakomia ino la litulungi ko la isosha esisofomo’mi la Ngɛnɛ, eoka shao sisofomo ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ Etanda, inga to ndomelekesa yao. Baseeli la baoi ba losilo
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

lokele: Isosila to, bitungani yami, tikalaka to la bolau. Ɔlwaka ndoengana, okaka liɔnjɔnji liami. Okanaka la wɛlï, yalanaka la lilatemi lilau, limɔ Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa losamɔ la lilatemi eyalakaka lanu.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

lokele: Lamolanaka la tochɔu etüchomu end’eba Etanda;
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

lokele: eba Etanda ono batotina batoseel’ino.
english: All the saints greet you.

lokele: Booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya la losamɔ loa Mungu angɛnɛ, la liyalani lia Bolimo Botanu, biyaleke lanu yaatotina.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
